newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: 17 killed, 37 injured in bus crash in Ethiopia.
newsitem.headline: 17 killed, 37 injured in bus crash in Ethiopia.

text.p: Seventeen people were killed and 37 injured when a bus plunged into a ravine in northern Ethiopia on Wednesday, the state-run Ethiopian News Agency said on Friday.
It said the bus was heading for the northern town of Dessie when it skidded and plunged into the ravine at Gorobola. The driver disappeared after the crash. Police were investigating.
